title: fix: C_* functions return CKR_FUNCTION_NOT_SUPPORTED before checking g_initialized
description:
pkcs11test Init.Uninitialized, Slot.NoInit confirm: when wolfP11 is not initialized, calling C_EncryptInit or C_InitToken returns CKR_FUNCTION_NOT_SUPPORTED instead of CKR_CRYPTOKI_NOT_INITIALIZED.

PKCS#11 2.40 §11.4: every C_* function except C_Initialize must return CKR_CRYPTOKI_NOT_INITIALIZED if the library has not been initialized. The initialized check must come BEFORE the 'function supported?' check.

Root cause: the WP11_LOCK macro (or equivalent guard) checks g_initialized and returns CKR_CRYPTOKI_NOT_INITIALIZED, but functions that return CKR_FUNCTION_NOT_SUPPORTED may be doing so before the lock/initialized check.

Fix: Move the g_initialized guard to be the first check inside every C_* function stub that currently returns CKR_FUNCTION_NOT_SUPPORTED, or ensure the WP11_LOCK/WP11_REQUIRE_INIT macro is applied uniformly.
